title.en: Communication Challenges in a Diverse, Global Marketplace
title.ms: Cabaran Komunikasi dalam Pasaran Global yang Pelbagai

en: Discuss the opportunities and challenges of intercultural communication
Define culture, explain how it is learned, and define ethnocentrism and stereotyping
Explain the importance of cultural variations and list eight categories of cultural differences
List four guidelines for adapting to any business culture
Identify seven steps to improve intercultural communication skills
ms: Bincangkan peluang dan cabaran komunikasi antara budaya
Takrif budaya, terangkan bagaimana ia dipelajari, dan takrif rasa bangsa sendiri paling baik dan stereotaip
Terangkan kepentingan kepelbagaian budaya dan senaraikan lapan kategori perbezaan budaya
Senaraikan empat garis panduan menyesuaikan diri dengan mana-mana budaya perniagaan
Kenal pasti tujuh langkah meningkatkan kemahiran komunikasi antara budaya

en: A broader range of views and ideas
A better understanding of diverse, fragmented markets
A broader pool of talent to recruit from
ms: Julat pandangan dan idea lebih luas
Pemahaman lebih baik tentang pasaran pelbagai dan berpecah
Kumpulan bakat lebih luas untuk diambil

en: Connecting with and motivating diverse employees
Ensuring messages are sent, received and properly encoded
ms: Memastikan mesej dihantar, diterima dan dikod dengan betul

blocks.en: We each belong to **several cultures** (ethnic, religious, professional groups), each with its own special language or customs. Culture is **automatic, coherent and complete** (slide 10).
blocks.ms: Kita masing-masing tergolong dalam **beberapa budaya** (kumpulan etnik, agama, profesional), dengan bahasa atau adat tersendiri. Budaya bersifat **automatik, koheren dan lengkap** (slaid 10).

en: Judging others according to your own standards
ms: Menilai orang lain mengikut piawaian sendiri

en: Fear of interaction with strangers and foreigners
Ascribing general attributes based on a person’s culture
ms: Menetapkan sifat umum berdasarkan budaya seseorang

en: Accepting multiple cultures on their own terms
ms: Menerima pelbagai budaya mengikut terma mereka

blocks.en: Slide 10 lists “Automatic, Coherent, Complete” without explanation. Extra (not in slides): these describe how culture works (learned automatically, forms a coherent picture, feels complete). Confirm with your textbook.
blocks.ms: Slaid 10 menyenaraikan “Automatic, Coherent, Complete” tanpa penerangan. Extra (bukan dalam slaid): ini menggambarkan cara budaya berfungsi. Sahkan dengan buku teks.

en: High-context: relies more on nonverbal, indirect, builds relationships. Low-context: relies more on verbal, direct, exchanges information
ms: Konteks tinggi: banyak bukan lisan, tidak terus, bina hubungan. Konteks rendah: banyak lisan, terus, tukar maklumat

en: Seek mutual ground; send and receive messages without judgment; be honest; show respect for cultural differences
ms: Cari titik persamaan; hantar dan terima tanpa penghakiman; jujur; hormati perbezaan budaya

en: Attitudes toward work and success; roles and status; use of manners; concepts of time; future orientation; openness and inclusiveness
ms: Sikap terhadap kerja dan kejayaan; peranan dan status; adab; konsep masa; pandangan masa depan; keterbukaan dan keterangkuman

en: Greetings, personal space, touching, facial expressions, eye contact, posture, formality
ms: Ucapan salam, ruang peribadi, sentuhan, ekspresi muka, pandang mata, postur, formaliti

en: Cultures that value youth; value age and seniority; have multiple generations in positions of value
ms: Budaya menghargai belia; menghargai umur dan kanan; pelbagai generasi dalam kedudukan bernilai

en: Perceptions of gender roles; representation in management; different communication styles; outdated concepts of gender and sexual orientation
ms: Tanggapan peranan jantina; perwakilan dalam pengurusan; gaya komunikasi berbeza; konsep lapuk jantina dan kecenderungan seksual

en: Personal beliefs and workplace issues; balance corporate culture and personal beliefs; balance employee freedom of expression with legal compliance
ms: Kepercayaan peribadi dan isu tempat kerja; imbang budaya korporat dan kepercayaan; imbang kebebasan bersuara dengan pematuhan undang-undang

en: Respect for individuals; sensitivity to differences; availability of assistive technologies
ms: Hormat individu; peka perbezaan; teknologi bantuan

blocks.en: Memory hook: C-L-S-N-A-G-R-A (Contextual, Legal, Social, Nonverbal, Age, Gender, Religious, Ability).

en: Become aware of your own biases
Be careful about applying the “Golden Rule”
Practise patience and maintain a sense of humour
Study other cultures: knowledge, ability and motivation; research and practice
Study other languages: career opportunities; common phrases; mobile apps and websites
Respect preferences for communication style: directness, formality, media preferences
Use interpreters, translators and translation software
Help others adapt to your culture
ms: Kaji budaya lain: pengetahuan, kebolehan dan motivasi; kajian dan latihan
Belajar bahasa lain: peluang kerjaya; frasa lazim; aplikasi mudah alih dan laman web
Hormati keutamaan gaya komunikasi: sifat terus, formaliti, keutamaan media
Guna jurubahasa, penterjemah dan perisian terjemahan
Bantu orang lain menyesuaikan diri dengan budaya anda

en: Choose words carefully; be brief; use plenty of transitions
Avoid slang, idioms and business jargon
ms: Pilih perkataan teliti; ringkas; guna banyak peralihan
Petik nombor dan tarikh dengan teliti
Elak slanga, simpulan bahasa dan jargon perniagaan
Elak jenaka dan rujukan budaya pop

en: Adjust content and style; mind the medium and circumstances
Be aware of nonverbal styles and cultural norms
Speak slowly and clearly without being condescending
Ask for feedback and rephrase as necessary
ms: Laras kandungan dan gaya; peka medium dan keadaan
Sedar gaya bukan lisan dan norma budaya
Bercakap perlahan dan jelas tanpa merendahkan
Minta maklum balas dan ungkap semula

en: Translators: for both spoken and written communication

blocks.en: Slide 25 (Figure 3.2) is an image. The slides describe interpreters as for spoken communication and translators as for both spoken and written, which differs from the common textbook split; use the slide wording.
blocks.ms: Slaid 25 (Rajah 3.2) ialah imej. Slaid menerangkan jurubahasa untuk lisan dan penterjemah untuk lisan dan bertulis, yang berbeza daripada pembahagian lazim buku teks; guna perkataan slaid.

q.en: Four benefits of international communication skills?

a.en: Increased profits, revenue, market share; more valued employees.
a.ms: Keuntungan, hasil, bahagian pasaran meningkat; pekerja lebih dihargai.

q.en: Three advantages of a diverse workforce?

a.en: Broader views and ideas, better understanding of diverse markets, broader talent pool.
a.ms: Pandangan lebih luas, fahami pasaran pelbagai, bakat lebih luas.

q.en: Three challenges of intercultural communication?

a.en: Connecting with and motivating diverse employees, harmony in diverse teams, messages sent/received/encoded properly.
a.ms: Berhubung dan motivasi, keharmonian pasukan, mesej dihantar/diterima/dikod betul.

q.en: What do cultural influences affect?

a.en: Language, nonverbal signals, word meaning, time and space, rules of human relationships.
a.ms: Bahasa, isyarat bukan lisan, makna perkataan, masa dan ruang, peraturan hubungan.

q.en: Define ethnocentrism.
q.ms: Takrif rasa bangsa sendiri paling baik.

a.en: Judging others according to your own standards.
a.ms: Menilai orang lain mengikut piawaian sendiri.

q.en: Define xenophobia.

a.en: Fear of interaction with strangers and foreigners.

q.en: Define stereotyping.

a.en: Ascribing general attributes to a person based on their culture.

q.en: Define cultural pluralism.

a.en: Accepting multiple cultures on their own terms.
a.ms: Menerima pelbagai budaya mengikut terma mereka.

q.en: Three ways to overcome ethnocentrism and stereotyping?
q.ms: Tiga cara mengatasi rasa bangsa sendiri paling baik dan stereotaip?

a.en: Avoid assumptions, withhold judgment, acknowledge distinctions.
a.ms: Elak andaian, tangguh penghakiman, akui perbezaan.

q.en: Name the eight categories of cultural differences.

a.en: Contextual, legal and ethical, social, nonverbal, age, gender, religious, ability.
a.ms: Konteks, undang-undang dan etika, sosial, bukan lisan, umur, jantina, agama, keupayaan.

q.en: High-context vs low-context cultures?

a.en: High: nonverbal, indirect, builds relationships. Low: verbal, direct, exchanges information.
a.ms: Tinggi: bukan lisan, tidak terus, bina hubungan. Rendah: lisan, terus, tukar maklumat.

q.en: Social differences include?

a.en: Attitudes toward work and success, roles and status, manners, concepts of time, future orientation, openness and inclusiveness.
a.ms: Sikap kerja dan kejayaan, peranan dan status, adab, masa, pandangan masa depan, keterbukaan.

q.en: Nonverbal differences include?

a.en: Greetings, personal space, touching, facial expressions, eye contact, posture, formality.
a.ms: Salam, ruang peribadi, sentuhan, ekspresi muka, pandang mata, postur, formaliti.

q.en: Three age cultures?

a.en: Value youth; value age and seniority; multiple generations in positions of value.
a.ms: Hargai belia; hargai umur dan kanan; pelbagai generasi.

q.en: Religious differences require balancing what?

a.en: Corporate culture vs personal beliefs; freedom of expression vs legal compliance.
a.ms: Budaya korporat lwn kepercayaan; kebebasan bersuara lwn pematuhan undang-undang.

q.en: Four guidelines for adapting to any business culture?

a.en: Be aware of own biases; careful with Golden Rule; tolerance, flexibility, respect; patience and humour.
a.ms: Sedar bias; hati-hati Golden Rule; toleransi, fleksibiliti, hormat; sabar dan humor.

q.en: Seven steps to improve intercultural skills?
q.ms: Tujuh langkah meningkatkan kemahiran antara budaya?

a.en: Study cultures; study languages; respect style preferences; write clearly; speak and listen clearly; use interpreters/translators; help others adapt.
a.ms: Kaji budaya; belajar bahasa; hormati gaya; tulis jelas; cakap dan dengar jelas; jurubahasa/penterjemah; bantu orang lain.

q.en: Four tips for writing clearly?

a.en: Choose words carefully, be brief, use transitions, cite numbers/dates carefully; avoid slang, idioms, jargon, humour.
a.ms: Pilih perkataan, ringkas, peralihan, petik nombor/tarikh; elak slanga, idiom, jargon, jenaka.

q.en: Interpreters vs translators (per slides)?

a.en: Interpreters for spoken communication; translators for both spoken and written.
a.ms: Jurubahasa untuk lisan; penterjemah untuk lisan dan bertulis.
